enchantment.simplecurses.flesh_armor.des: Equipment's armor is increased, but you lose maximum health while wearing it
enchantment.simplecurses.insomnia.desc: You cannot sleep. Phantoms spawn every night
enchantment.simplecurses.misfortune.desc: Greatly reduced Luck. Unfortunate events may happen to you
enchantment.simplecurses.sinking.desc: You sink faster while in water
enchantment.simplecurses.ignorance.desc: Breaking the wrong type of block with this tool causes severe durability damage
enchantment.simplecurses.wilting.desc: Crops around you break immediately. Crops in a larger radius do not grow
enchantment.simplecurses.death.desc: Lose maximum health if you get hit too many times, recover your health by killing mobs
enchantment.simplecurses.greed.desc: Has Fortune III, but take damage whenever gold, emeralds or diamonds enter your inventory
enchantment.simplecurses.envy.desc: Has Looting III, but take damage whenever you kill a mob
enchantment.simplecurses.gluttony.desc: Your exact Hunger level is hidden and you can eat when full
enchantment.simplecurses.sloth.desc: Reduced attack, mining and movement speed. Reduced further each night spent awake
enchantment.simplecurses.lust.desc: Whenever you breed animals, one more baby is born, but they cannot reproduce
enchantment.simplecurses.wrath.desc: Gain Strength and Speed whenever you kill X mobs, up to 5, but you have weakness and slowness otherwise
enchantment.simplecurses.pride.desc: If you are at full health, gain increased movement speed, jump height and damage, but if you are hit, gain mining fatigue, weakness and slowness.
